import re
import pytest
from target import url_basename

def old_url_basename(url):
    m = re.match(r'(?:https?:|)//[^/]+/(?:[^?#]+/)?([^/?#]+)/?(?:[?#]|$)', url)
    if not m:
        return u''
    return m.group(1)

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "url",
    [
        # simple paths
        "http://example.com/file",
        "https://example.com/file/",
        "http://example.com/dir/file.html",
        "https://example.com/dir/subdir/file.txt",
        # with query
        "http://example.com/file?query=1",
        "https://example.com/dir/file.html?foo=bar&baz=qux",
        # with fragment
        "http://example.com/file#section",
        "https://example.com/dir/file.html#anchor",
        # with both query and fragment
        "http://example.com/dir/file.html?x=1#y",
        # trailing slash after basename
        "http://example.com/dir/",
        "https://example.com/dir/subdir/",
        # root only (no basename)
        "http://example.com/",
        "https://example.com",
        # non‑http scheme (should not match)
        "ftp://example.com/file",
        "mailto:user@example.com",
        # multiple path components to test optional segment handling
        "http://example.com/a/b/c",
        "https://example.com/one/two/three/four",
        # path component containing dots and hyphens
        "http://example.com/.hidden/file-name.ext",
        # path component with URL‑encoded characters
        "http://example.com/%E6%BC%A2%E5%AD%97/file",
        # double slash after domain
        "http://example.com//double/slash",
        # path with question mark inside a segment (should stop matching)
        "http://example.com/segment?notpartofpath",
        # path with hash inside a segment (should stop matching)
        "http://example.com/segment#notpartofpath",
    ],
)
def test_url_basename_behaviour(url):
    assert url_basename(url) == old_url_basename(url)
